text:
Anna: heads-up — support flagged a cluster of customer pages around p95 after the staged runtime rollout (v0.8.3-experimental) started at 12:30 UTC :eyes:
Mike: which rollout window? canary at 10% or the gradual 50% step?
Anna: staged at 10% canary only so far (traffic split 90/10). we saw p95 jump from ~120ms to ~380ms on the gpu-4 pool. p50 unchanged.
Jess: do we have model IDs / request shapes? might be a specific long-seq workload hitting a slow path.
Anna: quick dump from the console: `model: open-bison-7b, seq: avg 512, tokens 600+, route: gpu-4`. support attached slow traces (linked): https://redwood.internal/trace/abc123
Nate: ok first step: throttle canary to 0% and rollback the canary traffic immediately if we confirm regression. canary should not be user-impacting. who can flip the split?
Sasha: I can flip it now. also starting a bisect on the runtime commits between 0.8.2 -> 0.8.3; kernel-selector tweak and allocator patch are suspects.
Lee: quick flamegraph from a canary replica attached — main hot path shows queuing in the batch scheduler and elevated context-switches.
Mike: that points to a scheduling change in 0.8.3. can we pin the old scheduler on the canary nodes?
Anna: ops-bot: update traffic-split canary=0
ops-bot: traffic split updated: canary=0%, stable=100% (ticket #INC-7123)
Anna: after throttling canary, support-bot: customers reporting fewer timeouts but some still see p95 around 300ms for a few minutes.
support-bot: Customer A (acct: acme) says latency is trending down after throttling. ongoing watch.
Sasha: running local binary with the allocator turned off shows p95 back to ~130ms. allocator patch likely regression. bisect step 3 isolates the allocator commit.
Nate: mitigation options: 1) temporary rollback of allocator patch in runtime build and redeploy canary, 2) a hotpatch to reduce max_batch_size from 64->16 for gpu-4 in config, 3) route long-seq traffic to alternative kernel.
Mike: do 2) immediately (config change) + 1) queued once we validate. smaller batch reduces queuing and will be quick to roll.
Lee: pushed hotpatch config: `runtime.pools.gpu-4.max_batch=16` to canary and stable for now, rolling in 2 mins.
ops-bot: config rollout started to pool gpu-4.
Anna: monitoring dashboards -> p95 down to ~140ms after config change. customers in the thread reporting improvement. :thumbsup:
Jess: need a follow-up: full bisect evidence, postmortem, and add an automated regression alert for p95 delta > 150ms in next rollout.
Nate: agree — will open postmortem and include steps to avoid merging allocator change without a perf microbenchmark.
Anna: filing the postmortem now (PM link forthcoming). Thanks all for fast triage.
Mike: add to runbook: if p95 spike with p50 stable -> check batching/scheduler/allocator first.
Sasha: saving bisect artifacts here: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/bisect/1743123456
support-bot: escalating customers notified, follow-up messages queued.
Anna: closing thread once the postmortem is up.
